Language is not comprised of natural signs that attach themselves to the real world. In the case of the body, tattoos are outer-directed speech, what Jakobson would call emotive-conative utterances, not inscriptions, or referential utterances, even if they were to say “my skin is here.” Speech is on things, on the outer edge of things, on a piece of rock, for example, but the lie it tells, obedient to language, is even then the dislocation of its referent.

所以，“约翰·多伊长眠于此”——但并非长眠于此，而是长眠于任何其他地方，唯独不在此处。因此，我们注意到，无处不在的墓志铭用语“谎言”才显得尤为重要。这句话本身就是谎言，不仅因为约翰·多伊并非长眠于此，而是在附近；还因为并非可怜的约翰·多伊本人撒谎，正如墓志铭所言，他并非指责死者。是语言使言语说谎，而且正如我们所见，这种说谎发生在诸多层面。墓志铭的奇妙之处在于，许多秉持我们姑且称之为“解构主义”传统的学者都曾指出：墓志铭是研究语言如何挑战、削弱和取代言语的绝佳切入点。

So “here lies John Doe”—except not here, anyplace but here. Hence the interest of the ubiquitous epitaphic word “lies,” which we have already noticed. The utterance is a lie, both because John Doe does not lie here but nearby and also because it’s not poor John Doe who tells a lie, as the epitaph claims, accusing the deceased. It’s language that’s making speech lie, and it’s doing so on any number of levels, as we’ve seen. It’s a funny thing about epitaphs, something that has been noted by various authors writing in the tradition of what we loosely call “deconstruction”: the epitaph is a particularly fruitful locus for the study of the ways language challenges, undermines, and displaces speech.

所以，言语之所以会说谎，是因为它永远无法摆脱语言的扭曲，因此我们永远不可能真正表达我们所说的意思。我们可以表达我们所说的意思，但我们无法真正表达我们所说的意思。这或许是最符合常理的解释。斯坦利·卡维尔在他的一本书的标题《我们必须表达我们所说的意思吗？》中提出了这个问题，他实际上是在告诉我们，也许表达我们所说的意思，无论我们能否做到，并非说话的全部意义所在。例如，雅各布森所说的“与接触建立联系”或寒暄功能就存在。当我轻敲麦克风说“测试一二三”时，我的意思真的是“一二三”吗？或者我必须像卡维尔所说的那样表达“一二三”吗？

So speech lies because it can never stop being warped by language, hence we can never possibly mean exactly what we say. We can mean what we say, but we can’t mean exactly what we say. That’s probably the most commonsensical way of putting the matter. When Stanley Cavell poses the question in the title of one of his books, Must We Mean What We Say?, he is actually offering us the possibility that maybe meaning what we say, whether we can do it or not, is not the be-all and end-all of speaking. There is, just for example, what Jakobson calls the “set to the contact” or phatic function. Do I mean, or must I mean, as Cavell puts it, “one two three” when I tap the microphone and say “testing one two three”?

现在你问——你真的应该问，毕竟语言一直是我们的指引——在《拖车托尼》中，语言是否通过言语表达。答案是肯定的。我之前提到过页面纵轴上那一列，每句话都以竖着的“我”开头。当你阅读文本时，它就在那里，这是献给拉康式女性主义的一份礼物：阳具中心傲慢地不断延伸，变成了“我”。然而，“我”绝不是婴儿说的第一个词。这是拉康的另一个启示。用朱迪斯·巴特勒的话来说，你必须学会​​如何成为“我”，因此，“我”就像《拖车托尼》中一根不可思议的直立支柱，一句接一句地贯穿全书，它向幼儿许下了自主的承诺：许诺了一种光荣的身份，它能够直立，成功地模仿了镜子中看到的自己，然后发展成弗洛伊德所说的“自我”，指的是婴儿开始在世界上获得自己想要的东西的方式。

Now you ask—you really should ask, because after all it’s been our constant guide—whether language speaks through speech in Tony the Tow Truck. Certainly it does. I spoke a while back about the column on the vertical axis of the page that begins each sentence with the vertical “I.” As you read the text, there it is, a gift to Lacanian feminism: the phallogocenter pompously getting longer, I. Yet I is never the first word spoken by an infant. That’s another lesson of Lacan. I is what you have to learn how to be—to put it in Judith Butler’s terms—so that I, insofar as it is this incredible upright pillar starting one sentence after another in Tony the Tow Truck, is the promise of autonomy to the toddler: the promise of the glorious kind of identity that stands upright, a successful simulacrum of what is seen in the mirror, and which then develops into what Freud called, referring to the way infants begin to get their way in the world, “his majesty the ego.”

但正如我所说，这是一个关于友谊的社交故事，最终“我”不再是第一个出现的。我认为，这一点也可以用一些语言学的方式传达给幼儿，虽然这些语言学方式不能称之为说话。例如，Bumpy（发音为BUM-py）和Tony（发音为TO-ny）之间的友谊就存在于“哎呀”这个声音中：在宝宝学会说“我”之前很久，他就会说“哎呀”，而这个“哎呀”的声音在Bumpy和Tony的友谊中回响。为什么是“哎呀”呢？因为Tony被困住了，他遇到这种情况的自然反应就是“哎呀”。这时Bumpy出现了，他无疑也想到了“哎呀”，他不仅发现了问题，还帮Tony解决了它。

But as I’ve said, this a socializing story about friendship, and the I eventually stops coming first. This too, I think, can be communicated as relevant to the toddler in ways that are linguistic yet can’t really be called speech. For example, the friendship exists between Bumpy (pronounced BUM-py) and Tony (pronounced TO-ny), in and through the sound of uh-oh: long before the baby says “I,” it says “uh-oh,” and that “uh-oh” echoes in the friendship of Bumpy and Tony. Why “uh-oh?” Because Tony is stuck and his natural response to being stuck would be, “Uh-oh.” Along comes Bumpy and—having no doubt thought “uh-oh,” too—not only does he recognize the problem, he takes care of it.

另一方面，自我问题，也就是被困于这种垂直“我”之中的问题，对于镜子前的婴儿来说，就变成了对他者的觉察，即对“非我”之物的觉察。那些无法被还原为自我的事物开始显现，而表达这种觉察的一种方式就是发出“咿咿”的声音，这或许是“嘿嘿嘿嘿”的伪装或拟态。我认为，故事中的两个反派角色，那些无法被同化、不提供任何帮助的“他者”，之所以被命名为“斯皮迪”（Speedy，发音为SPEE-dee）和“尼托”（Neato，发音为NEE-to），正是出于这个原因。换句话说，那种他者感——那种难以驾驭、无法有效被还原为自我的事物——我认为正是通过“咿咿”这个声音表达出来的。 （“Bum pee”和“To nee”分别提供了第三个和第四个“e”，但由于友谊使它们彼此认同，所以现在不重读。）因此，幼儿通过故事中的文字听到的不是言语，而是语言。如果你想在言语中听到语言，只需听听婴儿的说话。这就是为什么无厘头诗歌对幼儿如此有吸引力。他们仍然在聆听语言，就像华兹华斯《暗示颂》中岸边的孩子们聆听着波涛永不停息的巨浪一样。当成年人听到言语中蕴含的有效社交性时，他们听到的却是自己大脑深处的嗡嗡声。

Now on the other hand, the problem of self, the problem that’s caught up in this vertical I, comes into focus for the infant before the mirror as the awareness of otherness, that which is not me. That which is irreducible to the self begins to come into focus, and a way of expressing this is to say, “e-e-e-e,” which is perhaps a mask or simulacrum of “he-he-he-he.” I think it’s for that reason that the two antagonists of the story, the unassimilable others who do not help, are called Speedy (pronounced SPEE-dee) and Neato (pronounced NEE-to). In other words, that sense of otherness— that which is intractable and cannot be reduced effectively to self—is I think articulated in “e-e-e-e.” (Bumpee and Tonee provide the third and fourth “e,” but now unaccented, owing to the identification with the other enabled by friendship.) Thus what the toddler may hear spoken through the words of the story is not speech, it’s language. If you want to hear language in speech, just listen to a baby. That’s why nonsense verse has such appeal to young children. They’re still hearing language, like the children on the shore in Wordsworth’s “Intimations Ode” hearing the mighty waters rolling evermore. They’re hearing the hum in the shell of their brains when the adult hears the efficacious sociality of speech.

人类的历史就是一部与语言和解、掌握语言——或者更确切地说，或许是掌握语言——的历史。对于个体而言，亦是如此。天生具备语言能力的人，必须想方设法将这种能力转化为我们所谓的语言。因此，我们听到的第一个婴儿的声音，或许也是幼儿故事和无厘头诗歌中最主要的，是语言，而语言无法被简化为任何语义单元。当然，我刚才对托尼的语言进行了某种解读，仿佛它具有某种意义，但这种意义仅仅来源于对情感的观察，以及对儿童在实际场合所说的话的留意。这些话不能真正称之为语言，而更像是语言在向语言演进的过程中的一种实验。它绝非语言所能混淆，但就像镜像阶​​段一样，它仍然在某种程度上是对成人行为的模仿。当成年人偶尔说“哎呀”时，其意义远不及孩子，因为对孩子来说，这往往是他们学会的第一个清晰发音，因此会欣喜地重复。正如弗洛伊德笔下小汉斯玩“堡垒/达”游戏的故事一样，这声“哎呀”似乎表达的是与异己的相遇以及试图驾驭异己的尝试。

The history of being human is a history of coming to terms with speech, mastering speech—or, I should say, perhaps, mastering language. So it is, too, in the individual. The individual who is hardwired for language must somehow wrestle that hardwiring into what we call speech. So the first thing we hear in an infant, and maybe what is most predominant in stories for toddlers and in nonsense verse, is language, which can’t be reduced to any semantic quantum. Sure, I’ve just interpreted the language in Tony as though it had a kind of meaning, but it’s a meaning that comes simply from the observation of feelings and noticing what children actually say on actual occasions, which can’t really be called speech but is rather a kind of experimentation with language as it drags itself toward speech. It’s not anything that one could confuse with speech, yet it is still partly, as in the mirror stage, an imitation of being adult. When the adult occasionally says, “Uh-oh,” there’s nothing like the investment in it that there is for the child, for whom it is very often a first articulate sound, repeated therefore with delight. It is the encounter with otherness and the attempt to master otherness, as in Freud’s story of Little Hans playing his game of fort / da, that this “uh-oh” seems to be expressing.

托尼就说到这里吧。我只想用三个论点来总结一下——我是说，我想总结一下。注意，说话要非常谨慎，否则语言会干扰表达。我必须非常小心地说“三个论点”——当然，在那之前我犯了个错误。我不想说“混淆”，对吧？事实上，请注意，“混淆”这个词并非只是阻碍沟通的普通词汇。它正是我最不想说的，因为我一如既往地希望避免混淆，尤其是在总结的时候。我本来可以说其他任何词，但我却说了“混淆”。那是语言带着精神分析的负担凌驾于言语之上，一个弗洛伊德式的口误。

So much then for Tony. I’d just like to confuse—I mean I’d like to conclude—with three theses. Take note, you have to speak very carefully or language obtrudes. I had to say “three theses” very carefully—and of course I had made a mistake just before that. I didn’t want to say “confuse,” did I? Notice, in fact, that “confuse” was not just any old word getting in the way of communication. It was precisely what I did not want to say because I was hoping as always, but especially in concluding, to avoid confusion. I could have said anything else, but I said “confuse.” That was language overtaking speech with a psychoanalytic burden, a Freudian slip.

所以，关于语言，我有三个论点，其实它们本质上就是一个论点。首先，语言本身毫无意义。语言本身没有意义。它是任意的。它是一个由任意符号构成的系统，这些符号并非自然符号。是你赋予意义，而不是语言。你通过意图，通过驾驭语言，将其转化为言语，通过为己所用，从而赋予意义。语言本身没有意义；是你赋予意义。

So here are my three theses about language, which I suppose are really only one thesis. First, it never makes sense. Language does not make sense. It’s arbitrary. It is a system of arbitrary signs that are not natural signs. You make sense, not language. You make sense by having an intention and wrestling language into speech, commandeering language for your purposes. Language doesn’t make sense; you make sense.

其次，语言本身并不能说明现实，因为它是一个封闭的系统，一种代码，一套任意符号的系统。我想用两种不同的方式来说明，以证明我们的习语是如何印证这一论点的。正如我们所说，你会与现实达成共识。也就是说，你会用语言来接近现实；你会用语言来理解它，以便在言语中识别它。或者说，你会“弄明白”它。你会运用修辞手法来表达现实，正如你会与现实达成共识一样。

Language in itself, second, says nothing about reality because it is a self-enclosed system, a code, a system of arbitrary signs. I want to put this two different ways to show how our idioms confirm this thesis. You come to terms, as we say, with reality. That is to say, you approach reality with words; you come to it with language so that you can identify it in speech. Or again, you figure it out. You bring figures of speech to bear on reality just as you come to terms with it.

第三，借用一句你可能很熟悉的表达，我最后要说的是，通往现实的道路是由你的意图铺就的，无论这些意图是好是坏。

Third, to adapt an expression with which you’re probably familiar, I’ll conclude by saying that the road to reality is paved with your intentions, be they good or bad.

Passages Referenced in Lectures

第一章

For Chapter 1

因此，商品是一种神秘的事物，原因很简单：在商品中，人类劳动的社会属性以客观的形式呈现，并印刻在劳动成果之上……：要找到一个类比，我们必须求助于宗教世界那迷雾笼罩的领域。在那个世界里，人类大脑的产物被视为具有生命的独立个体，它们彼此之间以及与人类本身都存在着联系。商品世界也是如此，人类的劳动成果亦是如此。

A commodity is therefore a mysterious thing, simply because in it the social character of men’s labor appears to them as an objective character stamped upon the product of that labor …: To find an analogy, we must have recourse to the mist-enveloped regions of the religious world. In that world the productions of the human brain appear as independent beings endowed with life, and entering into relation both with one another and the human race. So it is in the world of commodities with the products of men’s hands.

——卡尔·马克思，《资本论》，塞缪尔·摩尔和爱德华·艾维林译，弗里德里希·恩格斯编（纽约：国际出版社，1967 年），第 1 卷，第 72-73 页。
—Karl Marx, Capital: A Critique of Political Economy, trans. Samuel Moore and Edward Aveling, ed. Frederick Engels (New York: International Publishers, 1967), 1:72–73.

那么，真理是什么？它是一支流动的隐喻、转喻、拟人化的军队：简而言之，它是人际关系的总和，这些关系在诗意和修辞上被强化、变形、装饰，并在长期使用后，对一个民族而言似乎是固定的、规范的、具有约束力的；真理是幻觉，而人们已经忘记了它们是幻觉：是陈旧的隐喻，它们已经无法触动感官；是正面被抹去的硬币，它们现在不再是硬币，而仅仅是金属。

What then is truth? A mobile army of metaphors, metonymies, anthropomorphisms: in short, a sum of human relations which became poetically and rhetorically intensified, metamorphosed, adorned, and after long usage, seem to a nation fixed, canonic, and binding; truths are illusions of which one has forgotten that they are illusions: worn-out metaphors which have become powerless to affect the senses, coins which have their obverse effaced and are now no longer of account as coins but merely as metal.

——弗里德里希·尼采，《论道德之外的真理与谎言》，马克西米利安·穆格译，载于奥斯卡·列维编， 《弗里德里希·尼采全集》（纽约：罗素与罗素出版社，1964 年），第 180 页。
—Friedrich Nietzsche, “On Truth and Lie in the Extra-Moral Sense,” trans. Maximilian Mügge, in The Complete Works of Friedrich Nietzsche, ed. Oscar Levy (New York: Russell and Russell, 1964), p. 180.

怀疑论学派由三位看似相互排斥的大师主导：马克思、尼采和弗洛伊德……“真理即谎言”或许可以用来概括这三种怀疑论实践。

Three masters, seemingly mutually exclusive, dominate the school of suspicion: Marx, Nietzsche, and Freud … “truth as lying” would be the negative heading under which one might place these three exercises of suspicion.

—保罗·利科，《弗洛伊德与哲学：论诠释》，丹尼斯·萨维奇译（纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，1970 年），第 32 页。
—Paul Ricoeur, Freud and Philosophy: An Essay on Interpretation, trans. Denis Savage (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1970), p. 32.

第三章

For Chapter 3

当我们与任何事物打交道时，仅仅是观察那些与我们最亲近的事物，其本身就蕴含着诠释的结构，而且这种结构如此原始，以至于要真正理解某种摆脱了“如是”的事物，就需要某种调整。当我们只是凝视某物时，我们仅仅拥有它本身，就意味着我们无法再理解它。这种摆脱了“如是”的理解，恰恰是缺乏那种仅仅理解的观看方式。它并不比那种观看方式更原始，而是源于那种观看方式。

When we have to do with anything, the mere seeing of the Things which are closest to us bears in itself the structure of interpretation, and in so primordial a manner that just to grasp something free, as it were, of the “as,” requires a certain readjustment. When we merely stare at something, our just-having-it-before-us lies before us as a failure to understand it any more. This grasping which is free of the “as,” is a privation of the kind of seeing in which one merely understands. It is not more primordial than that kind of seeing, but is derived from it.

——马丁·海德格尔，《存在与时间》，约翰·麦夸里和爱德华·罗宾逊译（牛津：布莱克威尔出版社，1962年），第190页。
—Martin Heidegger, Being and Time, trans. John Macquarrie and Edward Robinson (Oxford: Blackwell, 1962), p. 190.

在……一种诠释中，我们所诠释的实体的理解方式可以源于实体本身，也可以通过诠释将实体强加于与其存在方式相悖的概念之中。无论哪种情况，诠释都已预先决定了一种确定的理解方式，或最终确定，或有所保留；它基于我们预先把握的某种东西——一种先入为主的观念。

In … an interpretation, the way in which the entity we are interpreting is to be conceived can be drawn from the entity itself, or the interpretation can force the entity into concepts to which it is opposed in its manner of Being. In either case, the interpretation has already decided for a definite way of conceiving it, either with finality or with reservations; it is grounded in something we grasp in advance—in a fore-conception.

—马丁·海德格尔，《存在与时间》，约翰·麦夸里和爱德华·罗宾逊译（牛津：布莱克威尔出版社，1962 年），第 191 页。
—Martin Heidegger, Being and Time, trans. John Macquarrie and Edward Robinson (Oxford: Blackwell, 1962), p. 191.

如果一个人在进行某种具体的解释，即精确的文本解释时，喜欢诉诸于“客观存在的东西”，那么他就会发现，“客观存在的东西”首先不过是进行解释的人显而易见的、未经讨论的假设。

If, when one is engaged in a particular concrete kind of interpretation, in the sense of exact textual Interpretation, one likes to appeal to what “stands there,” then one finds that what “stands there” in the first instance is nothing other than the obvious undiscussed assumption of the person who does the interpreting.

—马丁·海德格尔，《存在与时间》，约翰·麦夸里和爱德华·罗宾逊译（牛津：布莱克威尔出版社，1962 年），第 192 页。
—Martin Heidegger, Being and Time, trans. John Macquarrie and Edward Robinson (Oxford: Blackwell, 1962), p. 192.

康德认为，道德行为的基础在于，人应当被视为目的本身，而非他人的工具。这一原则同样适用于人的言语，因为言语是人在社会领域的延伸和表达，而且，如果我们未能将人的意图与其言语联系起来，我们就失去了言语的灵魂——传递意义并理解其意图。

Kant held it to be a foundation of moral action that men should be conceived as ends in themselves, not as instruments of other men. This imperative is transferable to the words of men because speech is an extension and expression of men in the social domain, and also because when we fail to conjoin a man’s intention to his words we lose the soul of speech, which is to convey meaning and to understand what is intended to be conveyed.

—ED Hirsch，《解释的目的》（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1976 年），第 91 页。
—E. D. Hirsch, Aims of Interpretation (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1976), p. 91.

愉悦与善都与欲望能力相关，前者带来的是一种病态的、受冲动、刺激所制约的满足，后者带来的是一种纯粹的实践性满足，这种满足不仅取决于客体的表象，也取决于主体与客体存在之间的关联（即，主体——或自我——基于感性或道德理由，对客体产生渴望或排斥）。[康德将主体对客体的感性或道德倾向称为“利益”。]

Taste is the faculty of judging of an object or a method of representing it by an entirely disinterested satisfaction or dissatisfaction. The object of such satisfaction is called beautiful.

美与低于它的宜人，与高于它的善，两者之间立刻有了区别：因为宜人与宜人必然都与某种利益相关：它们都作用于意志，并激发对所设想的实际形象或对象的渴望。

所有艺术都是毫无用处的。

All art is quite useless.

美的体验超越了强大的道德意志，正如它超越了动物的激情一样，而事实上，这两者既是竞争的，又是协调的。

Language is not a function of the speaker; it is a product that is passively assimilated by the individual.

第十一章

For Chapter 11

我倾向于赋予文本一种内在的权威，我认为这种权威比德里达赋予文本的权威要强……从某种复杂的角度来看，我会坚持“文本自我解构，是自我解构的”这一说法，而不是被来自文本外部的哲学干预所解构。

I have a tendency to put upon texts an inherent authority, which is stronger, I think, than Derrida is willing to put on them.… In a complicated way, I would hold to the statement that “the text deconstructs itself, is self-deconstructive,” rather than being deconstructed by a philosophical intervention from outside the text.

For Chapter 17

当下的愉悦和表面上的欢愉，成了让听者免于思考整体的借口，而整体的内涵恰恰在于正确的聆听。听者沿着阻力最小的路径，最终沦为默许的购买者。局部的体验不再是对整体的批判；相反，它们阻碍了成功的审美整体对社会缺陷的批判。

The delight in the moment and the gay façade become an excuse for absolving the listener from the thought of the whole, whose claim is comprised in proper listening. The listener is converted, along his line of least resistance, into the acquiescent purchaser. No longer do the partial moments serve as a critique of the whole; instead, they suspend the critique which the successful esthetic totality exerts against the flawed one of society.

—TW Adorno，《音乐论集》，Susan H. Gillespie 译，Richard Leppert 编辑（伯克利：加州大学出版社，2002 年），第 291 页。

像贝尔格、勋伯格和韦伯恩这样的伟大现代主义作曲家被其他马克思主义者称为个人主义者，然而他们的作品不过是与那些摧毁个性的力量进行的一场对话——这些力量的“无形阴影”巨大地投射在他们的音乐之上。在音乐中，集体力量也在消灭一种无法挽救的个性，但只有个人才能自觉地代表集体的目标，与之抗衡。

[Great modernist composers like Berg, Schönberg, and Webern] are called individualists [by other Marxists], and yet their work is nothing but a single dialogue with the powers that destroy individuality—powers whose “formless shadows” fall gigantically on their music. In music, too, collective powers are liquidating an individuality past saving, but against them only individuals are capable of consciously representing the aims of collectivity.

—TW Adorno，《音乐论集》，Susan H. Gillespie 译，Richard Leppert 编辑（伯克利：加州大学出版社，2002 年），第 315 页。

第18章

For Chapter 18

让斯科特、巴尔扎克和德莱塞作为现代现实主义兴起的非时间顺序的标志；这些早期伟大的现实主义作品的特点在于其素材的根本性和令人振奋的异质性，以及与之相应的叙事技巧的多样性。在这样的时刻，对现实的体裁限制反而对文本的语域产生了一种悖论式的解放作用，并释放出一系列异质的历史视角——斯科特的过去、巴尔扎克的未来、德莱塞的商品化过程——这些视角通常被认为与关注历史当下相悖。事实上，这种多元的时间性往往在“高级”现实主义和自然主义中被封闭和重新约束，在这些作品中，完善的叙事技巧（特别是作者去人格化、视角统一和场景再现的三重要求）开始赋予“现实主义”一种令人窒息的自我惩罚的意味。正是在晚期资本主义这种逐渐物化的背景下，浪漫主义再次成为叙事异质性和摆脱现实原则的自由之地，而如今压迫性的现实表述却成了现实原则的囚徒。

Let Scott, Balzac, and Dreiser serve as the non-chronological markers of the emergence of realism in its modern form; these first great realisms are characterized by a fundamental and exhilarating heterogeneity in their raw materials and by a corresponding versatility in their narrative apparatus. In such moments, a generic confinement to the existent has a paradoxically liberating effect on the registers of the text, and releases a set of heterogeneous historical perspectives—the past for Scott, the future for Balzac, the process of commodification for Dreiser—normally felt to be inconsistent with a focus on the historical present. Indeed, this multiple temporality tends to be sealed off and recontained again in “high” realism and naturalism, where a perfected narrative apparatus (in particular the threefold imperatives of authorial depersonalization, unity of point of view, and restriction to scenic representation) begin to confer on the “realistic” option the appearance of an asphyxiating, self-imposed penance. It is in the context of this gradual reification in late capitalism that the romance once again comes to be felt as the place of narrative heterogeneity and freedom from the reality principle to which a now oppressive realistic representation is the hostage.

——弗雷德里克·詹姆逊，《政治无意识：叙事作为一种社会象征行为》（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，2002 年），第 90 页。
—Fredric Jameson, The Political Unconscious: Narrative as a Socially Symbolic Act (London: Routledge, 2002), p. 90.

哲学家们只是用各种方式解释世界；然而，关键在于改变世界。

The Philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways; the point, however, is to change it.

——卡尔·马克思，《关于费尔巴哈的第十一条提纲》（1845年），载于罗伯特·C·塔克编， 《马克思恩格斯读本》（纽约：W·W·诺顿出版社，1978年），第145页。
—Karl Marx, “Eleventh Thesis on Feuerbach” (1845), in The Marx-Engels Reader, ed. Robert C. Tucker (New York: W. W. Norton, 1978), p. 145.

诠释的多种形式

The Varieties of Interpretation

文学理论延伸阅读指南

A Guide to Further Reading in Literary Theory

斯特凡·埃斯波西托

STEFAN ESPOSITO

文学理论质疑那些影响阐释的条件和假设。这一点在其提出的问题类型中可见一斑。我们如何解读作者的思维过程与纸上文本之间的联系？我们如何解读抒情诗中政治和经济因素的意义？作者的性别、种族或性取向是否应该影响我们对小说的解读？不同的批评流派关注的重点各不相同，但所有质疑阐释本质的人文研究都源于诠释学的世俗化。希望加深对文学理论理解的学生，在深入研究其他文学和文化阐释理论之前，不妨先了解一下这一传统。

Literary theory questions the conditions and assumptions that inform interpretation. This is evidenced in the types of questions that theory asks. How do we interpret the link between an author’s thought process and the text that appears on paper? How do we interpret the significance of political and economic factors in a lyric poem? Should the gender, race, or sexuality of an author shape the way we read a novel? The focus of discrete critical schools differs significantly, but all humanistic studies that question the nature of interpretation share a common ancestor in the secularization of hermeneutics. Students wishing to deepen their understanding of literary theory would do well to consider this tradition before branching into other theories of literary and cultural interpretation.

弗里德里希·施莱尔马赫是现代诠释学发展史上的奠基人之一。在《论宗教：致其有教养的蔑视者》（1799 ）、《独白集》（1800；第二版，1810）、《对先前伦理学理论的批判纲要》（1803）以及《基督教信仰》（1821-1822，修订版，1830-1831）等著作中，施莱尔马赫将严肃诠释学的范畴从对神圣文本的晦涩论证扩展到人类交流的各个领域。他追随约翰·戈特弗里德·赫尔德的观点，认为一切思想都依赖于语言，并受其制约，甚至等同于语言。因此，他提出诠释学应当是一门普世学科，适用于法律和文学、口头文本和书面文本、现代文献和古代文献。

Friedrich Schleiermacher is a foundational figure in the development of modern hermeneutics. In works such as On Religion: Speeches to Its Cultured Despisers (1799), Soliloquies (1800; 2nd ed., 1810), Outlines of a Critique of Previous Ethical Theory (1803), and The Christian Faith (1821–1822, rev. ed., 1830–1831), Schleiermacher expanded the domain of serious interpretation from hermetic arguments about sacred texts to all spheres of human communication. Following Johann Gottfried Herder, Schleiermacher argues that all thought is dependent on and bounded by, or identical with, language. Accordingly, he proposed that hermeneutics should be a universal discipline, applicable to law as well as literature, to oral as well as written texts, and to modern as well as ancient sources.

若想阅读施莱尔马赫关于文学和哲学诠释学的优秀英文译本，可参阅安德鲁·鲍伊译的《诠释学与批评及其他著作》（剑桥：剑桥大学出版社，1998）。施莱尔马赫还著有最早的现代翻译理论专著之一——《论不同的翻译方法》 （1813）。劳伦斯·韦努蒂主编的《翻译研究读本》（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，2004）导论中概述了浪漫主义诠释学、文学理论和翻译研究之间的交集。

For a good English translation of Schleiermacher’s writings relevant to literary and philosophical hermeneutics, see Hermeneutics and Criticism and Other Writings, trans. Andrew Bowie (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1998). Schleiermacher is also responsible for one of the first modern treatises on translation theory, On the Different Methods of Translation (1813). A summary of the intersections among romantic hermeneutics, literary theory, and translation studies is found in the introduction to The Translation Studies Reader, ed. Lawrence Venuti (London: Routledge, 2004).

威廉·狄尔泰追随施莱尔马赫的脚步，但又深受利奥波德·冯·兰克历史主义的影响，试图将诠释学发展成为一门现代实验科学，其中包含着与假设检验相对应的诠释学方法。在鲁道夫·A·马克雷尔和弗里乔夫·罗迪编辑的《人文科学中历史世界的形成》（1910年，普林斯顿：普林斯顿大学出版社，2002年）一书中，狄尔泰论证道，诠释涉及一种间接的或中介式的理解，这种理解只有将人类的表达置于其历史语境中才能获得。在这种论述中，理解并非重构作者心境的过程，而是阐明作品中所表达的内容的过程。约斯·德·穆尔的《有限性的悲剧：狄尔泰的生命诠释学》（托尼·伯雷特译，纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，2004年）是一部优秀的评论性著作。

Following in Schleiermacher’s footsteps, but informed by Leopold von Ranke’s historicism, Wilhelm Dilthey attempted to turn hermeneutics into a modern experimental science involving the interpretive equivalent of hypothesis testing. In The Formation of the Historical World in the Human Sciences (1910), ed. Rudolf A. Makkreel and Frithjof Rodi (Princeton: Princeton University Press, 2002), Dilthey argued that interpretation involves an indirect or mediated understanding that can be attained only by placing human expressions in their historical context. In this account, understanding is not a process of reconstructing the state of mind of the author, but one of articulating what is expressed in the work. Jos de Mul, The Tragedy of Finitude: Dilthey’s Hermeneutics of Life, trans. Tony Burrett (New Haven: Yale University Press, 2004), is an excellent critical study.

这些诠释学先驱与现代文学理论之间的联系体现在马丁·海德格尔的现象学诠释学中。海德格尔拓展了诠释学的哲学范畴，他认为诠释学不仅仅是一门文本、语言或文化学科。正如施莱尔马赫所论证的，诠释学具有普遍意义。但根据海德格尔的观点，它也是一种本体论上的必然要求。理解，或者说阐释，不仅仅是一种阅读方法，也不仅仅是某种实验程序的结果。它并非我们对外部符号数据所做或试图做的事情，而是我们自身的一部分。海德格尔的巨著《存在与时间》（1927），由约翰·麦夸里和爱德华·罗宾逊翻译（伦敦：SCM出版社，1962年），开启了后来被称为诠释学本体论转向的进程。海德格尔的以下作品探讨了阐释的哲学和存在主义意义，并​​更明确地提及文学，尤其是诗歌，如何探究语言与存在之间的关系：《艺术作品的起源》，载于《诗歌、语言、思想》，阿尔伯特·霍夫施塔特译（纽约：哈珀柯林斯出版社，1971年）；《荷尔德林的赞美诗“伊斯特河”》，威廉·麦克尼尔和朱莉娅·戴维斯译（布卢明顿：印第安纳大学出版社，1996年）。若要对海德格尔作品中艺术与本体论之间的联系进行清晰而深入的分析，请参阅休伯特·德雷福斯的《海德格尔的艺术本体论》，载于《海德格尔导论》 ，H.L.德雷福斯和M.A.拉斯尔编（牛津：布莱克威尔出版社，2005年）。海德格尔对诠释学的本体论重新评估对文学理论影响最为深远，因为它为解构主义提供了哲学上的参照。关于这一遗产的详细评价，请参见约翰·卡普托的《激进诠释学：重复、解构与诠释学计划》（布卢明顿：印第安纳大学出版社，1987年）。

The link between these hermeneutic pioneers and modern literary theory is found in the phenomenological hermeneutics of Martin Heidegger. Heidegger expanded the philosophical scope of hermeneutics by arguing that it is not just a textual, linguistic, or cultural discipline. As Schleiermacher argued, hermeneutics is of universal import. But it is also, according to Heidegger, an ontological imperative. Understanding, or interpretation, is not just a method of reading or the outcome of some experimental procedure. It is not something we do or attempt to do to external symbolic data. It is something we are. Heidegger’s magnum opus, Being and Time (1927), trans. John Macquarrie and Edward Robinson (London: SCM Press, 1962), inaugurates what has come to be known as the ontological turn in hermeneutics. The following works by Heidegger address the philosophical and existential import of interpretation with more overt reference to how literature, poetry in particular, interrogates the relationship between language and being: “The Origin of the Work of Art,” in Poetry, Language, Thought, trans. Albert Hofstadter (New York: HarperCollins, 1971); Hölderlin’s Hymn “The Ister,” trans. William McNeill and Julia Davis (Bloomington: Indiana University Press, 1996). For a clear and probing analysis of the link between art and ontology in Heidegger’s work, see Hubert Dreyfus, “Heidegger’s Ontology of Art,” in A Companion to Heidegger, ed. H. L. Dreyfus and M. A. Wrathall (Oxford: Blackwell, 2005). Heidegger’s ontological reevaluation of hermeneutics has been most influential for literary theory insofar as it served as a philosophical foil for deconstruction. For a careful appraisal of this legacy, see John Caputo, Radical Hermeneutics: Repetition, Deconstruction, and the Hermeneutic Project (Bloomington: Indiana University Press, 1987).

现代诠释学与文学的其他重要交汇点可见于以下著作：汉斯-格奥尔格·伽达默尔，《真理与方法》（1960），乔尔·温斯海默和唐纳德·G·马歇尔译（纽约：Continuum出版社，1994）；詹尼·瓦蒂莫，《超越诠释：诠释学对哲学的意义》，大卫·韦伯译（斯坦福：斯坦福大学出版社，1997）；保罗·利科，《弗洛伊德与哲学：诠释论》，丹尼斯·萨维奇译（纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，1970）；《诠释的冲突：诠释学论文集》，唐·伊德编，威利斯·多明戈等人译（伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿：西北大学出版社，1974）；以及《时间与叙事》，共3卷，译者待定。 Kathleen McLaughlin 和 David Pellauer（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1984、1985、1988 年）。

Other important intersections of modern hermeneutics and literature can be found in the following works: Hans-Georg Gadamer, Truth and Method (1960), trans. Joel Weinsheimer and Donald G. Marshall (New York: Continuum, 1994); Gianni Vattimo, Beyond Interpretation: The Meaning of Hermeneutics for Philosophy, trans. David Webb (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 1997); Paul Ricoeur, Freud and Philosophy: An Essay on Interpretation, trans. Denis Savage. (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1970), The Conflict of Interpretations: Essays in Hermeneutics, ed. Don Ihde, trans. Willis Domingo et al. (Evanston, IL: Northwestern University Press, 1974), and Time and Narrative, 3 vols., trans. Kathleen McLaughlin and David Pellauer (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1984, 1985, 1988).

一些对现象学或本体论诠释学的批判也值得关注。这些批判对包括媒体研究以及文学和公共领域的社会学研究在内的各种批评运动都产生了相当大的影响。卡尔-奥托·阿佩尔的《理解与解释：先验语用学视角》 （马萨诸塞州剑桥：麻省理工学院出版社，1984）试图重新构建理解（ Verstehen）与解释（Erklärung ）之间的关系，以期对语言进行一种更务实、更科学的阐释。在诸如《论社会科学的逻辑》（1967，谢里·韦伯·尼科尔森和杰里·A·斯塔克译，马萨诸塞州剑桥：政体出版社，1988）和《交往行为理论》等著作中，也体现了类似的批判精神。托马斯·麦卡锡（Thomas McCarthy，马萨诸塞州剑桥：Polity出版社，1984-1987）指出，尤尔根·哈贝马斯批判了浪漫主义和现象学诠释学的意识形态内涵，尤其关注伽达默尔的传统概念和海德格尔本体论的政治内涵。哈贝马斯关于传播和公共领域的研究也对许多从事文化研究和印刷文化兴起研究的美国学者产生了深远的影响。迈克尔·华纳（Michael Warner）的《共和国的信件：十八世纪美国的出版与公共领域》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1990）和《公共领域与反公共领域》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：Zone Books出版社，2002）运用哈贝马斯的视角，对美国文学、文化、政治和宗教进行了精辟的分析。

A number of critiques of phenomenological or ontological hermeneutics are also worth noting. These have been quite influential to various critical movements, including media studies and sociological approaches to literature and the public sphere. Karl-Otto Apel’s Understanding and Explanation: A Transcendental-Pragmatic Perspective (Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1984) attempts to reformulate the relationship between understanding (Verstehen) and explanation (Erklärung) in pursuit of a more pragmatic, scientific account of language. In works such as On the Logic of the Social Sciences (1967), trans. Shierry Weber Nicholsen and Jerry A. Stark (Cambridge, MA: Polity Press, 1988), and The Theory of Communicative Action, trans. Thomas McCarthy (Cambridge, MA: Polity Press, 1984–1987), Jürgen Habermas criticizes the ideological implications of romantic and phenomenological hermeneutics, with special focus on Gadamer’s conception of tradition and the political implications of Heidegger’s ontology. Habermas’s work on communication and the public sphere has also been formative for many American scholars working in cultural studies and the rise of print culture. Michael Warner’s The Letters of the Republic: Publication and the Public Sphere in Eighteenth-Century America (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1990) and Publics and Counterpublics (Cambridge, MA: Zone Books, 2002) are astute analyses of American literature, culture, politics, and religion through a Habermasian lens.

读者反应批评也随之兴起，尤其是在康斯坦茨批评学派的成员中，它被视为对诠释学本体论转向的一种修正。这一模式的重要著作包括：彼得·乌韦·霍亨达尔的《接受美学导论》（载于《新德意志批评》第10卷，1977年，第29-63页）；诺曼·霍兰德的《文学反应的动力学》 （纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，1989年）；斯坦利·菲什的《罪的惊愕：〈失乐园〉中的读者》（纽约：麦克米伦出版社，1967年）；迈克尔·里法泰尔的《风格分析标准》（载于《词语》第15卷，1959年，第154-174页）。罗伯特·C·霍卢布的《接受理论：批判性导论》（伦敦：梅休恩出版社，1984年）是一本清晰的入门读物。《读者反应批评：从形式主义到后结构主义》（编者：[此处原文缺失，无法翻译]） Jane P. Tompkins（巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1980 年）是一部优秀的汇编。关于汉斯·罗伯特·尧斯所扮演的角色，请参阅保罗·德曼为尧斯的《走向接受美学》所作的导言，该书由蒂莫西·巴赫蒂翻译（明尼阿波利斯：明尼苏达大学出版社，1982 年）。

Reader-response criticism also emerged, especially amongst the members of the Konstanz school of criticism, as a corrective to the ontological turn in hermeneutics. Important works in this mode are: Peter Uwe Hohendahl, “Introduction to Reception Aesthetics,” New German Critique 10 (1977): 29–63; Norman Holland, The Dynamics of Literary Response (New York: Columbia University Press, 1989); Stanley Fish, Surprised by Sin: The Reader in Paradise Lost (New York: Macmillan, 1967); Michael Riffaterre, “Criteria for Style Analysis,” Word 15 (1959): 154–174. Robert C. Holub, Reception Theory: A Critical Introduction (London: Methuen, 1984), is a clear primer. Reader-Response Criticism: From Formalism to Post-Structuralism, ed. Jane P. Tompkins (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1980), is an excellent compendium. For the role played by Hans Robert Jauss, see the introduction by Paul de Man to Jauss’s Toward an Aesthetic of Reception, trans. Timothy Bahti (Minneapolis: University of Minnesota Press, 1982).

尽管本体论转向有时被批评为保守的知识分子运动，但它对于西方哲学传统的激进批判的兴起至关重要。深受海德格尔影响的让-保罗·萨特启发了一代法国知识分子重新思考文学的哲学意义。他的《何谓文学？》（1947），由伯纳德·弗雷希特曼翻译（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1988），是这方面的奠基之作。乔治·普莱在萨特、胡塞尔和海德格尔的现象学工作基础上，在其《阅读现象学》（载于《新文学史》 1.1，1969年10月，第53-68页）和《内在距离》（由埃利奥特·科尔曼翻译，巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1959）中，将阅读行为理论化为一种意识诠释学。

While it has been occasionally criticized as a conservative intellectual movement, the ontological turn in hermeneutics was central to the rise of radical critiques of the Western philosophical tradition. Heavily influenced by Heidegger, Jean-Paul Sartre inspired a whole generation of French intellectuals to reconsider the philosophical significance of literature. His What is Literature? (1947), trans. Bernard Frechtman (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press 1988), is a foundational text in this regard. Expanding upon the phenomenological work of Sartre, Husserl, and Heidegger, Georges Poulet theorized the act of reading as a hermeneutics of consciousness in his “Phenomenology of Reading,” New Literary History 1.1 (October 1969): 53–68, and The Interior Distance, trans. Elliott Coleman (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1959).

在当代学生眼中，俄国形式主义者的光芒已被他们的后继者米哈伊尔·巴赫金及其同时代人所掩盖，但仍有相当数量的英文文献可供参考。两篇描述性文章分别是：维克托·埃利希的《俄国形式主义》，载于《思想史杂志》第34卷（1973年：627-638页）；以及彼得·施泰纳的《俄国形式主义》，载于拉曼·塞尔登主编的《剑桥文学批评史》第8卷（剑桥：剑桥大学出版社，1995年）：11-29页。若想了解与艾肯鲍姆的研究类似的当代研究，可参阅鲍里斯·托马舍夫斯基的论文《俄国文学史新学派》（1928年），载于《现代语言协会出版物》第119卷（2004年：120-132页）。关于巴赫金，请参阅 Caryl Emerson 和 Gary Saul Morson 合著的《米哈伊尔·巴赫金》，载于 Michael Groden、Martin Kreiswirth 和 Imre Szeman 编辑的《约翰·霍普金斯文学理论与批评指南》第二版（巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，2005 年），以及 Katerina Clark 和 Michael Holquist 合著的《米哈伊尔·巴赫金》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1984 年）。

The Russian formalists have been somewhat eclipsed for contemporary students by their successors, Mikhail Bakhtin and his contemporaries, but there is still a substantial literature in English to consult. Two descriptive essays are: Victor Erlich, “Russian Formalism,” The Journal of the History of Ideas 34 (1973: 627–38) and Peter Steiner, “Russian Formalism,” The Cambridge History of Literary Criticism, ed. Raman Selden, vol. 8 (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1995): 11–29. For a contemporary survey of the movement similar to Eikhenbaum’s, see the translation of an essay by Boris Tomashevsky, “The New School of Literary History in Russia” (1928), Publications of the Modern Language Association 119 (2004: 120–132). On Bakhtin, see Caryl Emerson and Gary Saul Morson, “Mikhail Bakhtin,” The Johns Hopkins Guide to Literary Theory and Criticism, ed. Michael Groden, Martin Kreiswirth, and Imre Szeman, 2nd ed. (Baltimore: The Johns Hopkins University Press, 2005), and Katerina Clark and Michael Holquist, Mikhail Bakhtin (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1984).

与现象学、存在主义和俄国形式主义一样，费迪南·德·索绪尔的结构主义也是文学理论发展的重要思想催化剂。乔纳森·库勒的《结构主义诗学：结构主义、语言学与文学研究》（伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1975）和汉斯·阿斯莱夫的《从洛克到索绪尔：语言研究论文集》（明尼阿波利斯：明尼苏达大学出版社，1982）是研究这一传统的经典著作。库勒的《费迪南·德·索绪尔》（伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1986）也同样不可或缺。彼得·考斯的《结构主义：可理解的艺术》（纽约：人文出版社，1988）则探讨了结构主义的哲学意义。特伦斯·霍克斯的《结构主义与符号学》（伦敦：Methuen出版社，1977年）是一部文笔优美的研究著作，探讨了结构主义运动对文学阐释的影响。

Along with phenomenology, existentialism, and the Russian formalists, Ferdinand de Saussure’s structuralism was also a potent intellectual catalyst for literary theory. Jonathan Culler’s Structuralist Poetics: Structuralism, Linguistics, and the Study of Literature (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1975) and Hans Aarsleff’s From Locke to Saussure: Essays on the Study of Language (Minneapolis: University of Minnesota Press, 1982) are classic studies covering this tradition. Culler’s Ferdinand de Saussure (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1986) is also indispensable. Peter Caws, Structuralism: The Art of the Intelligible (New York: Humanities Press, 1988), explores the philosophical significance of structuralism. Terence Hawkes’s Structuralism and Semiotics (London: Methuen, 1977) is an elegantly written study of the movement’s consequences for literary interpretation.

与结构主义密切相关的关键人物是罗兰·巴特。他的早期思想，如《写作的零度》（1953年，安妮特·拉弗斯译，纽约：希尔与王出版社，1977年），有力地批判了萨特对实验性文学形式的幻灭。巴特后期的作品在马克思主义、结构主义和后结构主义批评之间摇摆不定。《神话学》（1957年，安妮特·拉弗斯译，纽约：法勒、斯特劳斯和吉鲁出版社，1972年）试图解构资产阶级社会日常形式（例如广告或摔跤比赛）中发挥作用的文化符号和符号系统。《S/Z》（1970年，理查德·米勒译，纽约：希尔与王出版社，1975年）是对巴尔扎克的小说《萨拉辛》进行的细致入微的符号学剖析。《图像、音乐、文本》 （纽约：希尔和王出版社，1977 年）一书中收录的文章，体现了一种激进的阅读观念，即阅读是在文本中进行无限游戏。

A key figure associated with structuralism was Roland Barthes. His early thinking in Writing Degree Zero (1953), trans. Annette Lavers (New York: Hill and Wang, 1977), is a forceful indictment of Sartre’s disenchantment with experimental literary forms. Later works by Barthes vacillate among Marxist, structuralist and poststructuralist criticism. Mythologies [1957], trans. Annette Lavers (New York: Farrar, Strauss, and Giroux, 1972), attempts to denaturalize the cultural symbols and sign systems at play in quotidian forms of bourgeois society, such as advertising or wrestling matches. S/Z (1970), trans. Richard Miller (New York: Hill and Wang, 1975), is a dense and detailed semiotic anatomy of Balzac’s story, “Sarrasine.” The essays collected in Image, Music, Text (New York: Hill and Wang, 1977) gesture toward a radical conception of reading as the enactment of infinite play in the text.

巴特思想的后一脉与文学理论和当代欧陆哲学中最重要的人物之一雅克·德里达的思想不谋而合。1967年出版的三部著作确立了德里达作为一位重要知识分子的地位，并为解构主义的兴起奠定了基础。解构主义是对西方形而上学传统的广泛批判，影响了人文学科乃至部分社会科学领域的学术研究。这三部奠基性著作分别是：《论文字学》（Gayatri Spivak译，巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1976年）；《写作与差异》（Alan Bass译，芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1980年）；以及《言语与现象及其他关于胡塞尔符号理论的论文》（David Allison译，埃文斯顿，伊利诺伊州：西北大学出版社，1973年）。德里达后期的著作将西方形而上学的解构应用于伦理和政治问题。例如，参见《马克思的幽灵：债务状况、哀悼工作和新国际》（伦敦：Routledge出版社，1994年）；《友谊政治》，乔治·柯林斯译（伦敦和纽约：Verso出版社，1997年）；以及《论款待》 ，雷切尔·鲍尔比译（斯坦福：斯坦福大学出版社，2000年）。

This latter strand of Barthes’s thought dovetails with one of the most important figures in literary theory and contemporary continental philosophy, Jacques Derrida. A trio of texts published in 1967 established Derrida as a major intellectual figure and laid the foundation for the rise of deconstruction, a wide-ranging critique of the Western metaphysical tradition that influenced academic work across the humanities and even some of the social sciences. These foundational texts are: Of Grammatology, trans. Gayatri Spivak (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1976); Writing and Difference, trans. Alan Bass (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1980); and Speech and Phenomena and Other Essays on Husserl’s Theory of Signs, trans. David Allison (Evanston, IL: Northwestern University Press, 1973). Later works by Derrida apply the deconstruction of Western metaphysics to questions of ethics and politics. See, for instance, Spectres of Marx: The State of the Debt, the Work of Mourning, and the New International (London: Routledge, 1994); Politics of Friendship, trans. George Collins (London & New York: Verso, 1997); and Of Hospitality, trans. Rachel Bowlby (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 2000).

在美国，以耶鲁学派为代表的解构主义催生了一系列重要的批评著作。《解构与批评》（纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，1979）收录了德里达、哈罗德·布鲁姆、杰弗里·哈特曼、J·希利斯·米勒和保罗·德曼等人的文章，展现了解构主义所启发的广泛研究方法。哈特曼在《拯救文本：文学/德里达/哲学》 （巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1981）中对德里达的实验性文学哲学拼贴作品《玻璃》（1974）进行了严谨的分析，为解构主义在批评史上的地位提供了更为务实的阐释。乔纳森·库勒的《论解构》（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，1983）则是对解构主义运动的理论基础和阐释路径的最佳评述。 Barbara Johnson 的《批判性差异：当代阅读修辞学论文集》（巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1980 年）、Carol Jacobs 的《伪装的和谐》（巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1978 年）和 Cynthia Chase 的《分解的形象：浪漫主义传统中的修辞解读》（巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯大学出版社，1986 年）都对文学和理论文本中存在的问题修辞结构进行了精湛的解读。

Deconstruction in America, championed by the Yale school, has produced a number of critical masterpieces. Deconstruction and Criticism (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1979) is a collection of essays by Derrida, Harold Bloom, Geoffrey Hartman, J. Hillis Miller, and Paul de Man, exhibiting the wide range of approaches that deconstruction has inspired. Hartman’s rigorous analysis of Derrida’s experimental literary-philosophical collage Glas (1974) in Saving the Text: Literature/Derrida/Philosophy (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1981) provides a more pragmatic account of deconstruction’s place in critical history. Jonathan Culler’s On Deconstruction (London: Routledge, 1983) is the best review of the theoretical underpinnings and interpretive moves implicit in the movement. Barbara Johnson’s The Critical Difference: Essays in the Contemporary Rhetoric of Reading (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1980), Carol Jacobs’s The Dissimulating Harmony (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1978), and Cynthia Chase’s Decomposing Figures: Rhetorical Readings in the Romantic Tradition (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins University Press, 1986) each enact virtuoso readings of the problematic rhetorical structure at play in literary and theoretical texts.

可以说，耶鲁学派中最具影响力和争议性的成员是保罗·德曼。他的主要著作，如《浪漫主义修辞学》（纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，1984）、《阅读的寓言：卢梭、尼采、里尔克和普鲁斯特作品中的修辞手法》（纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，1979）以及《盲目与洞察：当代批评修辞学论文集》（牛津：牛津大学出版社，1971），已成为文学理论的经典之作。德曼的文风比德里达更为晦涩却也更为直白，他巧妙地论证了华兹华斯、荷尔德林、雪莱和卢梭等作家作品中意义的不确定性。他的作品启发了一些同样精辟的评论，包括克里斯托弗·诺里斯的《保罗·德曼：解构与美学意识形态批判》（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，1988年）和鲁道夫·加舍的《阅读的王牌：论保罗·德曼》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1998年）。围绕德曼以及整个解构主义的争议，因其在二战期间于德占比利时撰写的合作主义文章的发现而愈演愈烈。这些带有民族主义色彩且偶尔带有反犹主义的文章仅占德曼新闻作品的一小部分，其全部作品收录于沃纳·哈马赫、尼尔·赫兹和托马斯·基南编辑的《战时新闻，1939-1943》（林肯：内布拉斯加大学出版社，1988年）。德曼的同事、学生和同时代人的反思、辩护和理论回应都收录在《回应：论保罗·德曼的战时新闻报道》中，由沃纳·哈马赫、尼尔·赫兹和托马斯·基南编辑（林肯：内布拉斯加大学出版社，1989 年）。

Arguably, the most influential and controversial member of the Yale school was Paul de Man. His major works, The Rhetoric of Romanticism (New York: Columbia University Press, 1984), Allegories of Reading: Figural Language in Rousseau, Nietzsche, Rilke and Proust (New Haven: Yale University Press, 1979), and Blindness and Insight: Essays in the Rhetoric of Contemporary Criticism (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1971), have become classics of literary theory. Writing in a dense but more straightforward style than Derrida, de Man artfully demonstrates the indeterminacy of meaning in writers such as Wordsworth, Hölderlin, Shelley, and Rousseau. His work has inspired some equally incisive commentaries, including Christopher Norris’s Paul de Man: Deconstruction and the Critique of Aesthetic Ideology (London: Routledge, 1988) and Rodolphe Gasché’s The Wild Card of Reading: On Paul de Man (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1998). The controversy surrounding de Man, and by extension deconstruction as a whole, was fueled by the discovery of collaborationist articles he wrote in German-occupied Belgium during World War II. These nationalist and occasionally anti-Semitic articles comprise a small minority of de Man’s journalistic output, collected in full in Wartime Journalism, 1939–43, ed. Werner Hamacher, Neil Hertz, and Thomas Keenan (Lincoln: University of Nebraska Press, 1988). Reflections, defenses, and theoretical responses from de Man’s colleagues, students, and contemporaries are collected in Responses: On Paul de Man’s Wartime Journalism, ed. Werner Hamacher, Neil Hertz, and Thomas Keenan (Lincoln: University of Nebraska Press, 1989).

解构主义对西方形而上学的激进批判也为许多法国女性主义思想家提供了重要的灵感来源。海伦·西苏与露西·伊里加雷一道，结合德里达的逻各斯中心主义概念和拉康的精神分析，发展出一套对父权制权力结构的哲学批判。在基思·科恩和保拉·科恩译的《美杜莎的笑声》（载于《符号》 1.4 (1976): 875–893）一文中，西苏呼吁一种新的女性写作模式，称之为“女性写作”（écriture féminine）。在吉莉安·C·吉尔译的《他者之镜》（1974，伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1985）和《非一的性别》（1977）中，西苏进一步阐述了这一观点。凯瑟琳·波特（伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1985）指出，伊里加雷倡导一种女性化的写作模式，以对抗主导西方哲学的单一真理观。法国女性主义理论传统中的另一位重要人物是朱莉娅·克里斯蒂娃。在她关于“符号学”的研究中，克里斯蒂娃关注语言的身体或物质经验，而非象征性的、隐含男性中心主义的指称意义领域。这一理论的主要著作是《符号学：对符号学的研究》（1969）[英文译本：《语言中的欲望：文学与艺术的符号学方法》（牛津：布莱克威尔出版社，1980）]。她后来的作品则聚焦于女性作家所面临的独特挑战。参见《女性天才：生活、疯狂、文字：汉娜·阿伦特、梅兰妮·克莱因、科莱特：三部曲》，3 卷（纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，2001 年）。

The radical critique of Western metaphysics pursued by deconstruction was also an important source of inspiration for a number of French feminist thinkers. Along with Luce Irigaray, Hélène Cixous developed a philosophical critique of patriarchal power structures by combining Derrida’s conception of logocentrism and Lacanian psychoanalysis. In “The Laugh of the Medusa,” trans. Keith Cohen and Paula Cohen, Signs 1.4 (1976): 875–893, Cixous calls for a new mode of feminine writing, termed “écriture féminine.” In Speculum of the Other Woman (1974), trans. Gillian C. Gill (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1985), and The Sex Which Is Not One (1977), trans. Catherine Porter (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1985), Irigaray espouses the need for a feminine mode of writing that resists the unitary conception of truth that dominates Western philosophy. Another important figure within the French feminist theoretical tradition is Julia Kristeva. In her work on the “semiotic,” Kristeva draws attention to the bodily or material experiences of language as opposed to the symbolic, tacitly phallocentric realm of denotative meaning. The principal statement of this theory is Séméiôtiké: Recherches pour une sémanalyse (1969) [English translation: Desire in Language: A Semiotic Approach to Literature and Art (Oxford: Blackwell, 1980)]. Later works have focused on the distinct challenges faced by female authors. See Female Genius: Life, Madness, Words: Hannah Arendt, Melanie Klein, Colette: A Trilogy, 3 vols. (New York: Columbia University Press, 2001).

许多美国女性主义者拓展了法国符号学与精神分析相结合的理论。简·加洛普（Jane Gallop）的著作尤为重要且精辟。参见《女儿的诱惑：女性主义与精神分析》（伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1982年）、《解读拉康》（伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1985年）以及《身体的思考》（纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，1988年）。加洛普还撰写了一部关于学院派女性主义文学研究的优秀著作：《1981年前后：学院派女性主义文学理论》（纽约：劳特利奇出版社，1991年）。托里尔·莫伊（Toril Moi）的著作广为流传，并被收入各种文集。莫伊对法国女性主义理论与其前身之间的差异提出了最为清晰的论证。在《性/文本政治：女性主义文学理论》（伦敦和纽约：梅休恩出版社，1985年）一书中，莫伊考察了英美女性主义，其代表人物包括伊莱恩·肖沃尔特、桑德拉·吉尔伯特、苏珊·古巴尔、凯特·米利特和安妮特·科洛德尼等理论家。莫伊认为，学术界的主流女性主义思潮阐述了一种本质主义的女性自我观，这种思潮既是自由人文主义的特征，又与之密切相关。在《何谓女人？及其他论文》（牛津和纽约：牛津大学出版社，1999年）一书中，莫伊重拾对英美女性主义的批判，并探讨了一种受克里斯蒂娃、西苏、伊里加雷和西蒙娜·德·波伏娃启发而来的女性身份认同的替代性概念。

Many American feminists have expanded upon the marriage of semiotics and psychoanalysis that emerged in France. The work of Jane Gallop is a particularly important and incisive example. See The Daughter’s Seduction: Feminism and Psychoanalysis (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1982); Reading Lacan (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1985); and Thinking Through the Body (New York: Columbia University Press, 1988). Gallop has also written an excellent account of academic feminist literary scholarship: Around 1981: Academic Feminist Literary Theory (New York: Routledge, 1991). The work of Toril Moi is widely read and anthologized. Moi provides the clearest argument for the differences between the theoretical work of French feminist theory and its predecessors. In Sexual/Textual Politics: Feminist Literary Theory (London and New York: Methuen, 1985), Moi surveys Anglo-American feminism, characterized by the works of such theorists as Elaine Showalter, Sandra Gilbert, Susan Gubar, Kate Millett, and Annette Kolodny. According to Moi, the dominant strand of feminism in academia articulates an essentialist conception of the female self, characteristic of and complicit with liberal humanism. In What Is a Woman? and Other Essays (Oxford and New York: Oxford University Press, 1999), Moi returns to this critique of Anglo-American feminism and pursues an alternative conception of female identity inspired by Kristeva, Cixous, Irigaray, and Simone de Beauvoir.

包括女性主义文学理论、酷儿理论以及更广泛的文化研究在内的性别与性取向文学研究，都深受米歇尔·福柯的影响。福柯的早期著作（1961年）是一部关于疯狂的文化和制度史：《疯狂史》（History of Madness），乔纳森·墨菲译（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，2006年）。他的《性史》（History of Sexuality），共三卷，罗伯特·赫尔利译（纽约：复古出版社，1988-1990年），影响深远，不仅在于其对性别与性的分析，还在于其对文化、权力与主体性之间关系的深刻理论洞见。福柯晚期的研讨会主要关注权力与知识在各种社会建构的异常或病态概念中的交织。参见《福柯精选集，1954-1984》（Essential Works of Foucault, 1954–1984），共三卷，保罗·拉比诺编（纽约：新出版社，1997-1999年）。关于福柯哲学意义的优秀辅助研究是 Hubert Dreyfus 和 Paul Rabinow 合著的《米歇尔·福柯：超越结构主义和诠释学》（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1983 年）。

Literary studies of gender and sexuality, including feminist literary theory, queer theory, and cultural studies more broadly are heavily indebted to the work of Michel Foucault. Foucault’s earliest work (1961) is a cultural and institutional history of madness: History of Madness, trans. Jonathan Murphy (London: Routledge, 2006). His History of Sexuality, 3 vols., trans. Robert Hurley (New York: Vintage Books, 1988–1990), has been extremely influential, both for its analyses of gender and sexuality and for its theoretical insight into the relationships among culture, power, and subjectivity. Late seminars focus on the imbrication of power and knowledge in various societal constructions of the abnormal or pathological. See Essential Works of Foucault, 1954–1984, 3 vols., ed. Paul Rabinow (New York: New Press, 1997–1999). An excellent secondary study on Foucault’s philosophical significance is Hubert Dreyfus and Paul Rabinow, Michel Foucault: Beyond Structuralism and Hermeneutics (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1983).

除了朱迪斯·巴特勒之外，众多理论家和批评家也借鉴福柯的理论来分析性别和性取向的文化及制度建构。苏珊·博尔多的《难以承受的重负：女权主义、西方文化与身体》（伯克利：加州大学出版社，1993）对西方社会中指导性别化身体解读的权力动态进行了精辟的分析。伊芙·科索夫斯基·塞奇威克的两部文学和文化批评杰作——《男人之间：英国文学与男性同性社交欲望》（纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，1985）和《衣橱的认识论》（伯克利：加州大学出版社，1990）——论证了同性恋-异性恋二元对立的形成是为了维护异性恋和男性主导地位。李·埃德尔曼的《同性恋书写：同性恋文学与文化理论论文集》（纽约：劳特利奇出版社，1994）运用解构主义和精神分析的视角重新阐述了性身份和性政治问题。在《酷儿理论：女同性恋和男同性恋的性取向》 （载于《差异：女权主义文化研究杂志》 3.3 (1991): iii–xviii）一文中，特蕾莎·德·劳雷蒂斯创造了“酷儿理论”一词，并论证了将其用于拓展关于性和性取向的论述视野的重要性。

In addition to Judith Butler, numerous theorists and critics have drawn on Foucault to analyze the cultural and institutional construction of gender and sexuality. Susan Bordo’s Unbearable Weight: Feminism, Western Culture, and the Body (Berkeley: University of California Press, 1993) offers an astute analysis of the power dynamics that guide interpretation of the gendered body in Western society. Eve Kosofsky Sedgwick’s two masterpieces of literary and cultural criticism, Between Men: English Literature and Male Homosocial Desire (New York: Columbia University Press, 1985) and Epistemology of the Closet (Berkeley: University of California, 1990), argue that the homosexual–heterosexual binary develops as an instrument to support heterosexuality and male dominance. Lee Edelman’s Homographesis: Essays in Gay Literary and Cultural Theory (New York: Routledge, 1994) rearticulates issues of sexual identity and politics through a deconstructive and psychoanalytic lens. In “Queer Theory: Lesbian and Gay Sexualities,” differences: A Journal of Feminist Cultural Studies 3.3 (1991): iii–xviii, Teresa de Lauretis coined the term “queer theory” and argued for its use as a way of opening up discursive horizons about sex and sexuality.

许多重要的女性主义理论家，包括盖亚特里·斯皮瓦克、舒拉米斯·费尔斯通和米歇尔·巴雷特，通过将精神分析和人类学批判与马克思主义社会理论相结合，拓展了女性主义理论的范畴。例如，参见巴雷特的《真理的政治：从马克思到福柯》（斯坦福：斯坦福大学出版社，1991年），或盖尔·鲁宾的《女性的交易：性政治经济学札记》，载于雷娜·拉普·雷特主编的《走向女性人类学》 （纽约：每月评论出版社，1975年）。

Many important feminist theorists, including Gayatri Spivak, Shulamith Firestone, and Michèle Barrett, have expanded the scope of feminist theory by yoking psychoanalytic and anthropological critique to Marxist social theory. See, for instance, Barrett’s The Politics of Truth: From Marx to Foucault (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 1991), or Gayle Rubin’s “The Traffic in Women: Notes on the Political Economy of Sex,” in Towards an Anthropology of Women, ed. Rayna Rapp Reiter (New York: Monthly Review Press, 1975).

当代马克思主义文学和文化理论中最具影响力的人物是弗雷德里克·詹姆逊。在《语言的监狱》（普林斯顿：普林斯顿大学出版社，1972）中接触结构主义理论之后，詹姆逊在一系列著作中发展出自己深受路易·阿尔都塞影响的文化理论，这些著作包括《侵略的寓言》（伯克利：加州大学出版社，1979）、《政治无意识》 （伊萨卡：康奈尔大学出版社，1981）以及《后现代主义，或晚期资本主义的文化逻辑》（达勒姆，北卡罗来纳州：杜克大学出版社，1991）。特里·伊格尔顿的《美学意识形态》（伦敦：布莱克威尔出版社，1991）是马克思主义批评领域的新经典。它将十八、十九世纪的美学理论置于各种意识形态和政治话语的语境中进行考察。埃内斯托·拉克劳和尚塔尔·穆夫的《霸权与社会主义战略》（伦敦：Verso出版社，1985年）虽然不太关注文学和艺术本身，但效仿安东尼奥·葛兰西的先例，分析了文化在使强加的权力结构自然化方面的作用。

The most influential figure in contemporary Marxist literary and cultural theory is Fredric Jameson. After engaging the structuralist project in The Prison House of Language (Princeton: Princeton University Press, 1972), Jameson developed his own theory of culture, heavily influenced by Louis Althusser, in a series of works that include Fables of Aggression (Berkeley: University of California Press, 1979), The Political Unconscious (Ithaca: Cornell University Press, 1981), and Postmodernism, or, The Cultural Logic of Late Capitalism (Durham, NC: Duke University Press, 1991). Terry Eagleton’s The Ideology of the Aesthetic (London: Blackwell, 1991) is a new classic of Marxist criticism. It situates eighteenth- and nineteenth-century aesthetic theories within a heterogeneous array of ideological and political discourses. Ernesto Laclau and Chantal Mouffe’s Hegemony and Socialist Strategy (London: Verso, 1985) is less focused on literature and art per se but, following the precedent of Antonio Gramsci, analyzes the role of culture in naturalizing imposed power structures.

詹姆逊的著作尤其受到后殖民理论家的批评，原因在于他在《跨国资本主义时代的第三世界文学》（载《社会文本》第15卷，1986年，第65-88页）一文中提出的一个观点。詹姆逊认为，所有第三世界文学都应以民族寓言的视角来解读，这可能会忽略其他有效的诠释方法。艾贾兹·艾哈迈德在《詹姆逊的“他者性修辞”与“民族寓言”》（载《社会文本》第17卷，1987年，第3-25页）一文中对詹姆逊的观点进行了有力的反驳。伊姆雷·塞门则在《谁害怕民族寓言？：詹姆逊、文学批评与全球化》（载《南大西洋季刊》第100卷第3期，2001年，第803-827页）一文中为詹姆逊辩护。关于后殖民主体发言、谈论后殖民主体或作为后殖民主体发言的困难的经典著作是盖亚特里·斯皮瓦克的《底层民众能说话吗？》，载于卡里·纳尔逊和劳伦斯·格罗斯伯格编辑的《马克思主义与文化的解释》（伦敦：麦克米伦出版社，1988 年）。

Jameson’s work in particular has been criticized by postcolonial theorists for a claim made in “Third-World Literature in the Era of Multinational Capitalism,” Social Text 15 (1986): 65–88. Here, Jameson argues that all third-world literature should be interpreted in terms of national allegory, potentially eliding other valid hermeneutic approaches. Aijaz Ahmad argues forcefully against Jameson in “Jameson’s Rhetoric of Otherness and the ‘National Allegory,’ ” Social Text 17 (1987): 3–25. A defense of Jameson is offered by Imre Szemen in “Who’s Afraid of National Allegory?: Jameson, Literary Criticism, Globalization,” South Atlantic Quarterly 100.3 (2001): 803–827. The classic work on the difficulty of speaking for, about, or as a postcolonial subject is Gayatri Spivak’s “Can the Subaltern Speak?” in Marxism and the Interpretation of Culture, ed. Cary Nelson and Lawrence Grossberg (London: Macmillan, 1988).

有很多优秀的批判性研究著作探讨了与法兰克福学派批评相关的非正统马克思主义学者：马丁·杰伊，《辩证的想象：法兰克福学派和社会研究所的历史 1923–1950》（伯克利：加州大学出版社，1996 年）；塞拉·本哈比卜，《批判、规范与乌托邦：批判理论基础研究》（纽约：哥伦比亚大学出版社，1986 年）；罗尔夫·维格豪斯，《法兰克福学派：其历史、理论和政治意义》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：麻省理工学院出版社，1995 年）；托马斯·惠特兰，《流亡中的法兰克福学派》（明尼阿波利斯：明尼苏达大学出版社，2009 年）。

There are a number of excellent critical studies of the heterodox Marxist scholars associated with the Frankfurt school of criticism: Martin Jay, The Dialectical Imagination: A History of the Frankfurt School and the Institute for Social Research 1923–1950 (Berkeley: University of California Press, 1996); Seyla Benhabib, Critique, Norm, and Utopia: A Study of the Foundations of Critical Theory (New York: Columbia University Press, 1986); Rolf Wiggerhaus, The Frankfurt School: Its History, Theories, and Political Significance (Cambridge, MA: MIT Press, 1995); Thomas Wheatland, The Frankfurt School in Exile (Minneapolis: University of Minnesota Press, 2009).

后殖民研究总体上如同曾经遭受殖民统治的国家一样丰富多彩。尽管如此，这一批判领域仍可辨识出一些奠基之作。艾梅·塞泽尔的《论殖民主义》（1950年），琼·平克汉姆译（纽约：每月评论出版社，2001年），以及弗朗茨·法农的《黑皮肤，白面具》（纽约：格罗夫出版社，1967年）是重要的先驱。法农运用精神分析理论探讨了殖民地臣民分裂的自我认知。​​类似的模式也体现在他关于阿尔及利亚独立斗争的研究著作《地球上的受苦者》（纽约：格罗夫出版社，1965年）中。阿尔伯特·梅米的《殖民者与被殖民者》（波士顿：灯塔出版社，1965年）则是一部准结构主义著作，阐述了统治者与臣民之间相互依存的关系。爱德华·萨义德的经典著作《东方主义》（纽约：Vintage Books出版社，1978年）分析了东方主义学术研究和对中东的想象性描绘中压迫性权力与知识的相互作用。沃尔特·米尼奥洛的《拉丁美洲的观念》（牛津：Blackwell出版社，2005年）采取了类似的方法，探讨了“拉丁美洲”这一术语发明背后殖民权力的矩阵。阿奇莱·姆贝姆贝的《论后殖民》 （伯克利：加州大学出版社，2000年）解读了主体性的表征——聚焦于暴力、惊奇和欢笑等体验——从而质疑了根深蒂固的非洲主义和本土主义观点，同时也探讨了后殖民理论的一些关键假设。在《黑人大西洋：现代性与双重意识》（纽约：Verso出版社，1993年）一书中，保罗·吉尔罗伊研究了非洲思想史及其文化建构，将遭受大西洋奴隶贸易之苦的人民重新塑造为离散民族不可避免的文化混杂性的象征。霍米·巴巴的《民族与叙事》（伦敦：Routledge出版社，1990年）和《文化的定位》（伦敦：Routledge出版社，1994年）则通过精神分析、解构主义和文化理论的独特融合，直面民族性和身份认同的复杂现实和模糊性。

Postcolonial studies in general are as varied as the countries that were subject to colonial rule. Nonetheless, some foundational works in this critical vein can be isolated. Aimé Césaire’s Discourse on Colonialism (1950), trans. Joan Pinkham (New York: Monthly Review Press, 2001), and Frantz Fanon’s Black Skin, White Masks (New York: Grove, 1967) are important forerunners. Fanon uses psychoanalytical theory to explore the divided self-perception of the colonial subject. A similar model informs his study of the Algerian struggle for independence, The Wretched of the Earth (New York: Grove, 1965). Albert Memmi’s The Colonizer and the Colonized (Boston: Beacon Press, 1965) is a quasi-structuralist account of the interdependent relationship between rulers and subjects. Edward Said’s classic Orientalism (New York: Vintage Books, 1978) analyzes the interplay of oppressive power and knowledge in Orientalist scholarship and imaginative portrayals of the Middle East. Walter Mignolo’s The Idea of Latin America (Oxford: Blackwell, 2005) takes a similar tack, exploring the colonial matrix of power behind the invention of the term “Latin America.” Achille Mbembe’s On the Postcolony (Berkeley: University of California Press, 2000) interprets representations of subjectivity—focusing on experiences such as violence, wonder, and laughter—to problematize die-hard Africanist and nativist perspectives, while also exploring some of the key assumptions of postcolonial theory. In The Black Atlantic: Modernity and Double Consciousness (New York: Verso, 1993), Paul Gilroy provides a study of African intellectual history and its cultural construction, recasting the peoples who suffered from the Atlantic slave trade as emblematic of the ineluctable cultural hybridity of diasporic peoples. Homi Bhabha’s Nation and Narration (London: Routledge, 1990) and The Location of Culture (London: Routledge, 1994) confront the problematic realities and ambiguities of nationality and identity via an idiosyncratic mix of psychoanalysis, deconstruction, and cultural theory.

非裔美国文学理论也是一个充满活力且涵盖广泛的批评研究分支。除了弗莱教授讲座中讨论的亨利·路易斯·盖茨和托妮·莫里森的作品外，该传统的一些经典著作包括：休斯顿·A·贝克的《布鲁斯、意识形态与非裔美国文学：一种本土理论》（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1984年）；艾迪生·盖尔主编的《黑人美学》（纽约：双日出版社，1971年）；克劳迪娅·泰特的《​​精神分析与黑人小说：欲望与种族规程》（牛津：牛津大学出版社，1998年）；罗伯特·B·斯特普托的《面纱之外：非裔美国文学研究》（厄巴纳：伊利诺伊大学出版社，1979年）。《非裔美国文学批评，1773年至2000年》，主编：[此处原文缺失，无法翻译]。 《黑兹尔·阿内特·欧文》（纽约：Twayne出版社，1999年）是一本很有用的汇编。

African American literary theory is also a vibrant and wide-ranging branch of critical study. In addition to the works by Henry Louis Gates Jr. and Toni Morrison discussed in Professor Fry’s lectures, some canonical works in this tradition are: Houston A. Baker, Blues, Ideology, and Afro-American Literature: A Vernacular Theory (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1984); The Black Aesthetic, ed. Addison Gayle Jr. (New York: Doubleday, 1971); Claudia Tate, Psychoanalysis and Black Novels: Desire and the Protocols of Race (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1998); Robert B. Stepto, From Beyond the Veil: A Study of Afro-American Literature (Urbana: University of Illinois Press, 1979). African American Literary Criticism, 1773 to 2000, ed. Hazel Arnett Ervin (New York: Twayne Publishers, 1999), is a useful compendium.

尽管女性主义、马克思主义和后殖民主义研究仍在借鉴精神分析的主题、概念和思想家，但近年来，以弗洛伊德和拉康的著作和思想为核心的研究却不幸地在理论领域逐渐式微。然而，哈罗德·布鲁姆的《影响的焦虑》（牛津：牛津大学出版社，1973）仍然是理解诗人与其先驱之间关系的重要典范。彼得·布鲁克斯的作品，如《为情节而读》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1983 年）、《身体工作：现代叙事中的欲望对象》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，1993 年）、《令人不安的忏悔：在法律和文学中谈论罪责》（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，2000 年）和《现实主义视野》（纽黑文：耶鲁大学出版社，2005 年），运用聚焦的精神分析视角来考察法律、文学和美学话语中修辞的变化。

While feminist, Marxist and postcolonial studies continue to draw upon psychoanalytic themes, concepts, and thinkers, studies foregrounding the works and ideas of Freud and Lacan have, unfortunately, faded somewhat from the theoretical landscape in recent years. Nevertheless, Harold Bloom’s The Anxiety of Influence (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1973) remains a powerful model for understanding the relationship between poets and their precursors. Peter Brooks’s works, such as Reading for the Plot (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1983), Body Work: Objects of Desire in Modern Narrative (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 1993), Troubling Confessions: Speaking Guilt in Law and Literature (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 2000), and Realist Vision (New Haven: Yale University Press, 2005), use a focused psychoanalytic lens to examine the rhetorical permutations at play in legal, literary, and aesthetic discourses.

精神分析理论最活跃的发展领域之一是创伤研究。肖莎娜·费尔曼与医生多莉·劳布合作的《证词：文学、精神分析与历史中的见证危机》（伦敦：劳特利奇出版社，1992年）是该子领域的奠基之作。与布鲁克斯一样，费尔曼的研究也常常与其他学科交叉，包括哲学、法学和人类学。她的《写作与疯狂：文学/哲学/精神分析》（斯坦福：斯坦福大学出版社，2003年）探讨了尼采、巴塔耶和内瓦尔等作家的写作与疯狂之间的关系。《司法无意识》（马萨诸塞州剑桥：哈佛大学出版社，2002年）则转向考察审判，特别是具有历史意义的审判，以及它们与集体创伤的关系。

One of the more vibrant developments of psychoanalytic theory is found in the field of trauma studies. Shoshana Felman’s collaboration with the physician Dori Laub in Testimony: Crises of Witnessing in Literature, Psychoanalysis, and History (London: Routledge, 1992) is a foundational text in this subfield. Like Brooks’s, Felman’s work often intersects with other disciplines, including philosophy, law, and anthropology. Her Writing and Madness: Literature/Philosophy/Psychoanalysis (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 2003) explores the relationship between writing and madness in writers such as Nietzsche, Bataille, and Nerval. The Juridical Unconscious (Cambridge, MA: Harvard University Press, 2002) turns to examine trials, especially trials of historic importance, and their relationship to collective trauma.

若想对一部奠基性的精神分析文本进行严谨而透彻的细读，菲利普·拉库-拉巴特和让-吕克·南希的合作研究《信的标题：雅克·拉康解读》（弗朗索瓦·拉富尔和大卫·佩蒂格鲁译，纽约州立大学出版社，1992年）是不可或缺的。该书是对拉康《无意识中的字母的能动性，或弗洛伊德以来的理性》一文的扩展解读。拉库-拉巴特和南希探讨了拉康文本以及更广泛的精神分析中系统性、基础和真理的修辞变化。斯拉沃热·齐泽克也对拉康的精神分析进行了拓展和探讨。他的《如何阅读拉康》（纽约：W.W.诺顿出版社，2007年）清晰易懂，又不失深刻，对核心概念和理论基础进行了精辟的阐述。由齐泽克主编的文集《关于拉康你一直想知道的一切（但你不敢问希区柯克）》（伦敦：Verso出版社，2010年）对包括《惊魂记》和《后窗》在内的经典电影进行了诸多生动的解读。《意识形态的崇高客体》 （伦敦：Verso出版社，1997年）则发展出一条连接黑格尔、阿尔都塞和拉康的思路，最终对主体性与意识形态之间的关系进行了辩证分析。

For a rigorous and thorough close reading of a foundational psychoanalytic text, Phillipe Lacoue-Labarthe and Jean-Luc Nancy’s collaborative study, The Title of the Letter: A Reading of Jacques Lacan, trans. Francois Raffoult and David Pettigrew (Albany: State University of New York Press, 1992), is indispensable. It is an extended reading of “The Agency of the Letter in the Unconscious, or Reason since Freud.” Lacoue-Labarthe and Nancy investigate the rhetorical permutations of systemacity, foundation, and truth in Lacan’s text, and psychoanalysis more generally. Slavoj Žižek also expands upon and engages with Lacanian psychoanalysis. His How to Read Lacan (New York: W. W. Norton, 2007) is a clear, accessible, yet incisive look at core concepts and theoretical foundations. An edited collection under Žižek’s direction, Everything You Always Wanted to Know about Lacan (But Were Afraid to Ask Hitchcock) (London: Verso, 2010), provides numerous lively engagements with classic films, including Psycho and Rear Window. The Sublime Object of Ideology (London: Verso, 1997) develops a line of thought linking Hegel, Althusser, and Lacan that results in a dialectical analysis of the relationship between subjectivity and ideology.

吉尔·德勒兹那些奇特且有时晦涩难懂的哲学论述深受精神分析的影响，二者之间存在着一种爱恨交织的关系。彼得·霍尔沃德的《超凡脱俗：德勒兹与创造哲学》（伦敦：Verso出版社，2006年）是对其著作的精彩阐释。同样深受拉康精神分析影响的阿兰·巴迪欧，将德勒兹视为一种智识上的参照，并提出了一种既不同于哲学诠释学也不同于传统美学的替代方案。参见他的《非美学手册》（阿尔贝托·托斯卡诺译，斯坦福：斯坦福大学出版社，2004年）和《存在与事件》（奥利弗·费尔瑟姆译，纽约：Continuum出版社，2005年）。

The strange and occasionally impenetrable philosophical interventions of Gilles Deleuze were heavily influenced, in a love-hate relationship, by psychoanalysis. Peter Hallward’s Out of This World: Deleuze and the Philosophy of Creation (London: Verso, 2006) is an excellent explication of his work. Equally informed by Lacanian psychoanalysis, Alain Badiou has used Deleuze as an intellectual foil while presenting an alternative to both philosophical hermeneutics and traditional aesthetics. See his Handbook of Inaesthetics, trans. Alberto Toscano (Stanford: Stanford University Press, 2004), and Being and Event, trans. Oliver Feltham (New York: Continuum, 2005).

上述各种理论流派和阐释模式通常被视为对美国新批评派观点的替代或修正。任何文学和文学理论专业的学生都应该阅读与20世纪中期这场运动相关的革命性批评文本。事实上，如果没有新批评派的方法论和教学创新，文学理论对文化话语的细致分析将不复存在。关于新批评细读与各种理论流派之间联系的更深入探讨，请参阅威廉·J·斯普林和迈克尔·费舍尔合著的《新批评与当代文学理论》（纽约：加兰出版社，1995年）。

The various schools and modes of theoretical interpretation mentioned above often present themselves as an alternative or corrective to ideas formulated by the American New Critics. Any student of literature and literary theory would do well to read the revolutionary critical texts associated with this mid-twentieth-century movement. Indeed, the close analysis of cultural discourses enacted by literary theory would not exist but for the methodological and pedagogical innovations of the New Critics. For an extended discussion of the connections between New Critical close reading and various strands of theory, see William J. Spurlin and Michael Fischer, The New Criticism and Contemporary Literary Theory (New York: Garland Publishing, 1995).

克林斯·布鲁克斯的论文《新批评》（载于《塞瓦尼评论》 87.4，1979年）清晰而深刻地阐述了新批评运动的核心假设、目标和方法。这些方法在其著作《精雕细琢的瓮》（纽约：哈考特·布雷斯出版社，1947年）和与罗伯特·佩恩·沃伦合著的《理解诗歌》（纽约：亨利·霍尔特出版社，1938年）中精湛的解读中得以充分展现。马克·温切尔的《克林斯·布鲁克斯与现代批评的兴起》（夏洛茨维尔：弗吉尼亚大学出版社，1996年）敏锐地阐述了布鲁克斯在塑造现代文学研究，以及或许更为重要的，英语教育教学法方面所起的奠基性作用。约翰·克罗·兰索姆的《新批评》（纽约：哈考特·布雷斯出版社，1947年）回顾了艾亚·理查兹、T·S·艾略特和伊沃·温特斯的著作，指出他们是文本研究新方法的先锋，这种方法关注语义和诗歌的心理效应，而非品味或作者的心理。理查兹的代表作《实用批评》（伦敦：凯根·保罗·特伦奇·特鲁布纳出版社，1929年）是对阐释过程本身的实证研究，使用了从学生那里收集的自我报告数据。关于美国南方新批评与保守的农业政治运动之间的联系，可参阅保罗·K·康金的《南方农业主义者》（诺克斯维尔：田纳西大学出版社，1988年）。新批评派在当时理论层面的主要竞争对手是“芝加哥学派”的新亚里士多德主义批评家，他们认为，如果没有经过深思熟虑的体裁框架，就无法可靠地进行阐释。参见RS Crane，《克林斯·布鲁克斯的批评一元论》，载于Crane编，《批评家与批评：古代与现代》（芝加哥：芝加哥大学出版社，1952年）。

Cleanth Brooks’s essay “The New Criticism,” Sewanee Review 87.4 (1979), is a clear and incisive statement of the central assumptions, goals, and methods of the movement. These methods are displayed by the virtuoso readings in The Well Wrought Urn (New York: Harcourt Brace, 1947) and Understanding Poetry, with Robert Penn Warren (New York: Henry Holt, 1938). Mark Winchell’s Cleanth Brooks and the Rise of Modern Criticism (Charlottesville: University Press of Virginia, 1996) is an astute articulation of Brooks’s foundational role in shaping modern literary studies and, perhaps more important, pedagogy in English education. John Crowe Ransom’s The New Criticism (New York: Harcourt Brace, 1947) reviews the work of I. A. Richards, T. S. Eliot, and Yvor Winters, identifying them as the vanguard of a new way of looking at texts that focuses on semantics and the psychological effect of poetry rather than on taste or the psychology of the author. Richards’s masterpiece, Practical Criticism (London: Kegan Paul, Trench, Trubner, 1929), is an empirical investigation of the interpretive process itself, using self-report data gleaned from students. For an interesting account of the link between New Criticism in the American South and the conservative agrarian political movement, see Paul K. Conkin’s The Southern Agrarians (Knoxville: University of Tennessee Press, 1988). The New Critics’ chief rivals at the level of theory in their own time were the “Chicago school” of neo-Aristotelian critics who held that interpretation could not be reliably practiced without a well-considered generic framework. See R. S. Crane, “The Critical Monism of Cleanth Brooks,” in Crane, ed., Critics and Criticism: Ancient and Modern (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1952).

当然，已有许多书籍承担了与本书类似的调查任务（包括戴维·里希特（David Richter）的著作，他也是本书选集的编辑，我们鼓励读者在听讲座时购买该选集：里希特，《坠入理论：关于文学阅读的冲突观点》 ，第二版（贝德福德/圣马丁出版社，2000年））。其中，我们特别推荐两本。第一本是因为它是新批评时期关于文学理论的首要汇编（也承认本书的书名借鉴自此书）：勒内·韦勒克和奥斯汀·沃伦，《文学理论》（纽约：哈考特出版社，1949年）；第二本是因为它是对当时（相对较近的）批评运动的出色总结，每一章都对一种理论立场进行了清晰而冷静的概述，直到最后一两页才抛出马克思主义的论调：特里·伊格尔顿，《文学理论导论》。（马萨诸塞州剑桥：布莱克威尔出版社，1996 年）。

There are of course any number of books that have undertaken the survey task of this one (including a book by David Richter, the editor of the anthology we have encouraged readers to purchase in conjunction with these lectures: Richter, Falling Into Theory: Conflicting Views on Reading Literature, 2nd ed. (Bedford/ St. Martin’s, 2000). Among these, we single out two, the first because it was the premier compendium, in the moment of the New Criticism, of what the theory of literature might be (and in acknowledgment that the title of the present volume is stolen from it): René Wellek and Austin Warren, Theory of Literature (New York: Harcourt, Brace, 1949), and the second because it is just an excellent summary of critical movements at its (fairly recent) time, each chapter a lucid and dispassionate summary of a theoretical position until the last page or two, when the Marxist card is played: Terry Eagleton, Literary Theory: An Introduction (Cambridge, MA: Blackwell, 1996).

以上列举的选篇当然无法涵盖文学理论的全部范畴。研习理论的乐趣和学术价值之一，就在于发现新的思想家，并追溯启发他们的文献来源。结合之前的讲座，弗莱教授和我希望这些阅读材料能够启发学生和终身学习者，让他们探索自己的研究路径，重新思考我们对文学阐释和体验的固有认知。

The selections referenced above certainly do not encompass the full variety of theories of literature. Part of the fun and intellectual richness associated with studying theory is the process of discovering new thinkers, and hunting down the sources that inspired them. Coupled with the preceding lectures, Professor Fry and I hope that these readings might inspire students and lifelong learners to chart their own course, rethinking assumptions about interpretation and our experience of literature.
